name: q-pilot
description: Runs browser tasks and UI tests from a prompt, like jev-ultrafast: Claude writes the task, Jev (TypeSafe) picks every step, Playwright executes it, and a live inspector shows and pauses each decision. Tests are graded by code, never by Jev's DONE; a passing test can be saved as a flow that the stop gate replays with no model when Claude edits UI.

jevApiKey.title: TypeSafe Jev API key
jevApiKey.description: Optional. The Jev key for driving tasks and tests, recording and healing. This option wins; when empty, TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment is used. Every other setting is set with /q-pilot config. Never put the key in q-pilot.config.json: that file is committed.
